newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Thailand's Bank of Ayudhya BBB/A-2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Thailand's Bank of Ayudhya BBB/A-2.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it had assigned its BBB long term and A-2 short term counterparty credit ratings to Thailand's Bank of Ayudhya Public Co Limited. S&P said the ratings outlook was stable.
"The ratings reflect the bank's solid market position and sound business franchise in Thailand, a satisfactory loan loss record and sound earnings and capital," the ratings agency said.
S&P said that similarly to other Thai banks, Bank of Ayudhya had experienced strong growth, which gave rise to concerns about potentially embedded asset quality problems.
"However, these concerns will only become apparent as the bank's loan portfolio matures," S&P said.
"While mitigated by conservative underwriting standards, BAY has a rather high, albeit reducing, portion of its loan portfolio exposed to the real estate sector," it said.
"As a result, the bank's credit profile remains sensitive to any future deteroration in this sector," S&P said.
Bank of Ayudhya is Thailand's fifth largest bank with a market share of 8.2 percent of assets and 9.1 percent of deposits.
